6c04091f70368ea1.job_title: Rotating Equipment Engineer (Diesel Engine Specialist) Saudi Arabia
6c04091f70368ea1.description: We are seeking an experienced Rotating Equipment Engineer specializing in industrial diesel engines to join the Mechanical Services Shops. The role focuses on diesel-engine overhaul engineering, troubleshooting, diagnostics, performance testing, repair planning, and root cause analysis (RCA) for engines used in oil and gas applications. Key Responsibilities Plan and supervise diesel-engine overhauls, including inspection, repair scope, dimensional checks, and component clearances. Troubleshoot diesel-engine mechanical systems, fuel injection, turbochargers, cooling, lubrication, governors, electronic controls, and protection systems. Ensure proper engine assembly, quality control, timing, torque settings, and compliance with OEM specifications. Conduct dynamometer and load testing to evaluate engine performance, vibration, temperature, pressure, emissions, and fuel consumption. Perform failure analysis and root cause investigations, recommending corrective actions and reliability improvements. Review OEM manuals, technical specifications, test results, and diagnostic data to ensure safe and reliable engine operation. Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Automotive, Marine, or Power Engineering from a recognized and approved program. Total Experience: Minimum 15 years of experience in engine or rotating equipment engineering . Relevant Experience: Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in industrial diesel-engine overhaul, diagnostics, and performance testing . Strong expertise in diesel-engine mechanical systems, fuel injection, turbochargers, cooling, lubrication, governors, controls, and protection systems. Hands-on experience with OEM diagnostic software, borescope inspection, vibration analysis, dynamometer or load-bank testing, and root cause analysis. Ability to interpret OEM manuals, technical specifications, engine test curves, alarm logs, and electronic control data. Preferred Qualifications Relevant OEM diesel-engine training and certifications. Mobius vibration analysis certification. ICML MLA I or equivalent lubrication certification.

6c16237322962c78.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجيال ذات البيان عن أخصائي نفسي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على البحث في الأنشطة النفسية المشتركة بين الأفراد، وتحديد المبادئ التي تفسر السلوك البشري في تفاعله مع المحفزات المحيطة. كما يتضمن إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة في مجال علم النفس. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة جميع مظاهر الحياة النفسية من خلال تحليل جوانب السلوك المختلفة مثل السلوك الحركي، العقلي، الانفعالي، والاجتماعي. تحليل مبادئ التعلم لحالات التعلم الإنساني وأشكاله المتعددة. إجراء دراسات ميدانية لتطبيق اختبارات الذكاء والأداء بهدف قياس أنماط النمو العقلي والنفسي. دراسة المبادئ والقوانين العامة لاستخلاص الأسس المميزة للسلوك الإنساني. تحليل وتطوير الاتجاهات والقيم الاجتماعية بناءً على المعلومات المستنبطة من المراقبة والمتابعة أو البحوث والتجارب الميدانية. دراسة وتطوير النظريات والاستخدامات التطبيقية في مجال تعديل السلوك. دراسة الأسس البيولوجية للسلوك من خلال التعرف على أجزاء الجهاز العصبي وتأثيرها على السلوك. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في علم النفس، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال علم النفس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء البحوث والدراسات الميدانية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لفهم السلوك البشري وتفسيره. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الأخصائي النفسي ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تعزيز الفهم النفسي وتطوير الحلول السلوكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة اجيال ذات البيان، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

6c1a70592c052f56.description: POSITION OVERVIEW The Network & Security Engineer is a hands-on implementation role responsible for designing, deploying, and securing customers’ enterprise routing, switching, and firewall infrastructure. The role delivers projects from design through handover, ensures the performance, reliability, and security of customer networks, and works directly with customers, Project Management, Pre-Sales, and vendor teams to deliver solutions in line with networking and security best practices. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Switching & Routing Design, deploy, configure, and troubleshoot Layer 2 switching technologies on Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, HP, or similar platforms. Design, deploy, and troubleshoot Layer 3 routing, including static routing, OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP. 2. Network Security Configure, maintain, and optimise enterprise firewalls, including Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco ASA/Firepower, and Sophos XG. Implement and optimise site-to-site and remote-access VPNs (IPsec, SSL VPN, DMVPN). Deploy and troubleshoot load balancing (LB) and web application firewall (WAF) solutions. Design, deploy, and manage Network Access Control (NAC) solutions (Cisco, Aruba, or similar). Support the deployment and integration of cybersecurity solutions (e.g., SIEM log integration, ZTNA / SASE, secure access) where skills allow. 3. SD-WAN & Wireless Implement and support SD-WAN solutions such as FortiGate SD-WAN, Palo Alto, or similar. Support the design and deployment of enterprise wireless networks. 4. Project Delivery & Customer Engagement Prepare technical documentation, including high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, test procedures, and as-built documents. Execute testing and site acceptance (SAT, FAT) activities, and support customer handover. Communicate and present technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders. Apply security and networking best practices to all delivered solutions. 5. Pre-Sales & Internal Coordination Provide technical input to pre-sales activities such as BOQs and scope of work, where required. Coordinate with the Project Manager on task status, risks, and schedule, and keep project trackers up to date. Raise and follow up vendor TAC cases where required, and share lessons learned with the technical team. QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical / Communications Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of hands-on implementation experience in enterprise networking and security, preferably in an IT system integrator environment. Proven track record of end-to-end delivery — design, deployment, migration, testing, and handover — on enterprise, government, or BFSI projects. Strong hands-on, multi-vendor experience with Cisco, Aruba, Huawei, Palo Alto, and Fortinet platforms. Experience with network and firewall migrations and complex troubleshooting in live production environments. Certifications (Mandatory) At least one valid expert or senior professional-level certification is mandatory: CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCIE Security, Palo Alto PCNSE, Fortinet NSE 7 / FCSS, or an equivalent (e.g., Check Point CCSE, Aruba ACEP / ACX). CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure or Security) is a strong advantage. Additional professional-level certifications (e.g., CCNP Enterprise / Security) are an advantage. Core Skills & Competencies Expert-level skills in routing, switching, wireless networking, and network security technologies. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects against deadlines. Customer-focused approach with strong stakeholder management. Clear, structured technical documentation skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English. Willingness to travel to customer sites as required. Desired Candidate Profile Desirable Skills — Cybersecurity (Optional) SIEM / log management (e.g., FortiSIEM, Splunk, QRadar) and SOC integration. Endpoint security (EDR / XDR) and email / web security gateways. Zero Trust, ZTNA, and SASE solutions (e.g., Prisma Access, FortiSASE, Zscaler). Privileged Access Management (PAM) and identity-based access controls. Vulnerability assessment tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys) and security hardening. Familiarity with NCA ECC and other Saudi cybersecurity compliance requirements.

6cd55ca1c9c94570.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an App Security Expert based in Saudi Arabia. As an App Security Expert, you will help strengthen application security by designing realistic security test environments and evaluating vulnerabilities in traditional and AI-powered applications. You will focus on emerging security challenges associated with large language models (LLMs), including sensitive information disclosure and excessive agency. Through hands-on security engineering, you will develop deterministic test cases, create evaluation frameworks, and establish reliable methods for distinguishing vulnerable code from secure implementations. You will also contribute to advancing AI-powered static analysis and agent-based security architectures. Working in a remote, technically driven environment, you will collaborate with security specialists to refine testing methodologies and improve evaluation quality. This role is ideal for an experienced application security professional passionate about secure software development, AI security, and building practical solutions to complex cybersecurity challenges. Accountabilities Design and implement purpose-built application fixtures containing representative security vulnerabilities or secure implementations, with a focus on OWASP risks affecting large language model applications. Develop realistic test scenarios addressing critical LLM security concerns, including sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, and related application security weaknesses. Create deterministic test cases and comprehensive security-context manifests to evaluate application security posture consistently and reliably. Develop detailed reference solutions and hidden answer keys that enable accurate evaluation of vulnerable versus secure code by AI systems and security scanners. Assess and refine testing pipelines, ensuring synthetic security tasks are realistic, technically challenging, reproducible, and suitable for application security evaluation. Build, inspect, and secure application codebases, identifying advanced vulnerabilities and implementing appropriate remediation strategies. Contribute to the design and evaluation of security architectures for traditional applications and agent-based systems. Apply knowledge of AI-powered static application security testing (AI-SAST) and LLM security to improve automated vulnerability detection and assessment methodologies. Document technical findings, testing approaches, security insights, and remediation recommendations in clear, precise, and actionable formats. Collaborate with distributed teams through effective written and verbal communication, providing constructive feedback and reviewing peers' technical contributions. Support the continuous improvement of security evaluation pipelines by identifying weaknesses, proposing enhancements, and validating new testing approaches. Requirements Extensive experience in application security, secure software development, cybersecurity engineering, or a related field, ideally with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. Strong understanding of application security principles, secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment, and remediation techniques. Familiarity with OSWE-level application security concepts, advanced vulnerability research, and practical security testing methodologies. Solid knowledge of large language model security, including common LLM vulnerabilities, prompt-related attack vectors, sensitive information disclosure, and excessive agency. Experience with AI-powered static application security testing (AI-SAST), automated code analysis, or AI-assisted security evaluation. Proven ability to design, implement, secure, and test application codebases, including identifying complex vulnerabilities and validating secure implementations. Experience designing or evaluating security architectures for traditional software applications and agent-based systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop realistic security scenarios and distinguish meaningful vulnerabilities from superficial test cases. Familiarity with deterministic testing methodologies, synthetic security fixtures, or structured evaluation frameworks is highly desirable. Excellent technical writing skills, including the ability to document security findings, testing procedures, methodologies, and actionable recommendations with precision. Strong verbal communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to review peer contributions and communicate complex security concepts clearly. Ability to work independently, manage technical tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality contributions in a fully remote environment. A proactive mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement in application security, AI security, and emerging cybersecurity practices. Benefits Competitive hourly compensation: Earn between $40 and $80 per hour, depending on experience and expertise. Fully remote work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world. Long-term contract: Initial 12-month engagement, offering the opportunity to contribute to ongoing security evaluation initiatives. Full-time commitment: Approximately 40 hours per week for consistent involvement in project delivery. Flexible independent engagement: Work as a freelancer or independent contractor. Immediate availability: The project is scheduled to begin as soon as possible. Cutting-edge technical challenges: Work on application security, LLM vulnerabilities, AI-powered security analysis, and agent-based architectures. Meaningful technical impact: Help improve the reliability and effectiveness of security testing methodologies and automated vulnerability evaluation. 6cc3590b02b63bb8.description: Job Purpose: Operates in all clinic areas and in-patient areas to conduct echocardiogram (TTE and TEE), stress testing (treadmill, Dobutamine and thallium / Sestamibi with the nuclear imaging), and 24 hour holter (ECG) and BP monitoring procedures. Performs on patients of both sexes and all nationalities, thus ethical and cultural sensitivities are of paramount importance in the way the work is done. Coordinates with the cardiologists and specialists for supervision and reports. Key Responsibilities and Duties: 1. Echocardiograms Transthoracic Echocardiogram ( TTE ): Performs 2D echo Doppler studies on adult, pediatric and neonatal patients and writes down the preliminary results. Notifies cardiologists of suspected abnormalities necessitating immediate attention (e.g. Pericardial tamponade, cardiac tumors, malfunctioning valve prosthesis and complex congenital heart disease, etc.). Prepares reports / videos of patients for official reading of the Consultant Cardiologist. Maintains documentation and down-time equipment used in the Echo lab. Maintains statistics, patient record and area monthly report. Reports to supervisor / department head any staff problems / malfunction of the echo equipment. Requests and obtains outpatients charts on all scheduled patients. Maintains supplies as needed for the examination room. Maintains daily the examination room in a clean and orderly environment for patient care (including changing the bed sheets). Maintains daily census record of Echo procedures completed. 2. Trans-esophageal Echocardiogram ( TEE ) if applicable: Performs pre-procedure equipment preparation and sterilization and acquisition of signed consent form. Acquires quick history and physical examination about the nature of the disease. Helps the patient to understand what to expect, alleviate anxiety and enhance compliance during TEE examination. Also a brief drug and allergy history or dysphagia or esophageal disease should be elicited. line to administer sedation or emergency medications. Advises patient to remove dentures and places the mouth piece. Instructs the patient to lie on his left lateral position with neck and knee bent forward and swallowing during intubations with nasal breathing. Be alert in monitoring vital signs and complications. Monitor s the patient after the procedure at least 1-2 hours for potential complication of the procedures, anesthetic or sedative. Maintains census record of the procedure completed. 3. Stress Test: Treadmill Exercise Test, Dobutamine Stress Test, Exercise Sestamibi and Presenting Sestamibi. Prior to the test, explains the procedure to the patient: to dress comfortably ( e.g. loose fitting, light weight clothing and sports shoes not to eat a heavy meal 4-8 hours before the test Asks the patient to sign a consent form as per policy. Explains the procedure in detail and re-assure the patient if he/she is anxious. Garment/s above the waist should be removed temporarily in order to attach 10 disposable electrodes. Prepares the skin area where the electrodes are to be attached like shaving the area if necessary, rubbing the skin vigorously with alcohol swabs. Connects the lead wires to the patient s electrodes (lead wires are color coded). Position the cable yoke so that the cable does not interrupt the patient when he/she is on the treadmill. Records ECG preferably with the patient lying and standing. Takes the patient s blood pressure, preferably with the patient lying and standing. Sets the maximum heart rate to be reached for the patient in question. Ensures the crash cart is ready for use should an emergency arise. Maintains daily census record of the procedure completed. 4. Holter Monitoring: Explains the test to the patient. Asks the patient to remove clothing above the waist. Skin preparation: shaves hair if necessary, rub the electrodes sites several times with alcohol swabs. Attaches the electrodes for a two channel recording as shown in the operator s manual. Fix the electrodes with adhesive plaster. Attaches the cable lead wires following color coding as shown in the operator s manual. Makes stress loops to prevent from pulling the electrodes. After 24 hours, switch off the monitor and disconnect the patient cable lead wires from the electrodes. Take off and discard the electrodes. Process the unit in the computer by typing all the necessary information about the patient, scanning and saving the ECG tracings recorded for 24 hours then to be ready for analyzing of the specialist / consultant cardiologist. Maintains daily census record of the procedure completed. 5. Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring: Explains the test to the patient and its indication. Sets the machine to check blood pressure every 15-30 minutes during the day and every 1-2 hours during sleeping time. After 24 hours, disconnect from the patient and scan it in the computer. Maintains daily census record of procedure completed. 6. Educates patients and their families about health conditions, treatments and preventative measures if applicable. Experience : Minimum of 3 years of practical experience Education : BS Medical Technology or any related medical field Language: English and Arabic preferred. Licenses / Certifications: License for practice as per the regional health regulatory authority e.g. (SCFHS / DHA), ACLS and BLS Desired Candidate Profile

The HR Director will work within a new automotive platform, contributing to its foundational development. 6c72fc430f55ecb1.description: About the Role شركة مستوى السلامة, a contracting company, is seeking a Qualification and Document Coordinator to join its sales and qualification department in Riyadh. This full-time role is essential for managing contractor-company registration and qualification processes, handling critical documentation, and preparing tender files. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage and update official and regulatory documents, ensuring their validity and readiness for use. Register and qualify the company with government entities, major corporations, and various supplier and contractor portals, following applications through to completion. Prepare prequalification files and utilize platforms such as Etimad, Muqawil, and major-company supplier portals. Organize past-performance records, including contracts, completion certificates, award letters, and handover documents. Maintain personnel, professional certificate, and qualification files, manage an electronic archive, and track renewals. Coordinate qualification requirements and tender/bid documentation with internal departments. Track tender deadlines, purchase tender documents, verify submission completeness, and report on registrations, documents, and opportunities. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in engineering (preferably electrical or civil), business administration, or a related administrative discipline. At least two years of experience in a Saudi contracting company in qualification, document management, or procurement. Proven experience in registering and qualifying contracting companies with government entities and major corporations. Good knowledge of Etimad procedures and supplier registration/qualification portals. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, along with PDF handling and electronic archiving. Arabic proficiency and good English reading and writing skills. Strong organizational skills, accuracy, follow-up, prioritization, deadline management, and coordination abilities. Residence in Riyadh is required. Preferred Qualifications Contractor qualification experience with Saudi Aramco or the Saudi Electricity Company. Familiarity with Etimad, Muqawil, Qiwa, Mudad, and social insurance platforms. Experience with document control or quality management systems, tender and proposal preparation, and advanced Excel reporting. A valid driving license. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and operates on a full-time schedule within the company's sales and qualification department. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure efficient document and qualification processes. 6c7fd263d8e41936.description: About the Role Catrion Group is seeking a Jr. Sous Chef to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves overseeing food preparation and production within a healthcare operation, ensuring high standards, quality, and adherence to specifications. The Jr. Sous Chef will collaborate with various departments, supervise kitchen staff, and contribute to efficient daily operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare and cook all food items according to agreed standards and contract specifications for healthcare operations. Ensure meals are produced in accordance with company standards, client requirements, and project specifications, served at correct temperatures with appropriate quality and portion sizes. Collaborate with all kitchen sections and related departments to ensure smooth daily operations. Supervise kitchen staff performance and provide assistance as needed. Participate in daily production, taking responsibility for assigned sections and overseeing junior staff in other areas. Monitor production to control food waste in line with business requirements. Assist in completing daily, weekly, and monthly HACCP records and other required documentation. Ensure harmonious teamwork among kitchen staff for timely production. Suggest alternative raw materials when primary items are unavailable and inform relevant sections. Verify correct packing and dispensing procedures for meal delivery. Ensure all food items used meet agreed purchase specifications and report any poor-quality items. Maintain personal and staff working hygiene standards in compliance with company and statutory requirements. Ensure all working areas are consistently clean. Ensure adequate manpower based on scheduled operational demands and workload. Assist in evaluating junior staff, identifying development gaps, contributing to improvement plans, and supporting grievance or disciplinary procedures. Support planning for stores and deliveries based on business needs. Report incidents such as fire, loss, damage, unfit food, irregularities, and food complaints, taking appropriate action. Attend client and company training courses and actively participate in safety initiatives. Attend daily meetings, briefings, and training sessions as required. Perform additional duties and tasks as requested, within competency, to support client/contract services. Contribute to the preparation of kitchen cleaning rosters and supervision of cleaning schedules. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in a culinary role, preferably within a healthcare or high-volume food production environment. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and requires a willingness to work in various locations across KSA as assigned by the department manager. It is a full-time position focused on maintaining high standards in a dynamic healthcare catering setting.

6c93b34fe1e2d96e.description: About the Role Abbott is seeking a Medical Science Liaison (Biosimilar) to join its Established Pharmaceuticals division. This full-time position is based out of the Jeddah field site location. The role focuses on providing scientific and technical support within the relevant therapeutic area, particularly for biological/biosimilar products. Role Context The Established Pharmaceuticals division at Abbott is committed to expanding access to trusted medicines in fast-growing countries. The portfolio includes high-quality, differentiated branded generic medicines across multiple therapeutic areas such as gastroenterology, women's health, cardiometabolic, pain management/central nervous system, and respiratory. This role contributes to maintaining professional relationships with key opinion leaders and academic centers to ensure access to current medical and scientific information. Key Responsibilities Provide scientific and technical support to maintain professional relationships with key opinion leaders and academic centers. Act as a scientific expert in the therapeutic area and develop resources for the therapy team. Assist with special projects including medical affairs, continuing medical education, advisory boards, KOL development, scientific reviews, local clinical trials, and investigator clinical meetings. Provide specialist support for internal and external queries, ensuring prompt provision of accurate scientific and medical information, including adverse event reporting. Maintain contact with physicians and opinion leaders in the assigned geographic area to address their scientific knowledge needs. Deliver credible presentations on scientific matters to physicians, individually or in groups. Establish and develop relationships with medical specialist groups and societies to expand research, advisory, and educational partnership opportunities. Participate in identifying qualified physicians and KOLs for collaborative efforts, ensuring scientific and educational integrity. Develop awareness of competitor issues and intelligence, communicating relevant information internally. Attend relevant Scientific Societies meetings and Conferences, summarizing key messages for internal use. Assist physicians with requests for access to Company products on a named patient or compassionate use basis, adhering to legal and regulatory requirements. Support sales, marketing, and internal teams by delivering scientific update presentations to enhance their expertise. Ensure up-to-date knowledge of product uses and external data through medical trainings for the therapeutic area team. Provide scientific and technical support to key opinion leaders and internal medical/clinical teams for publications. Ensure all activities comply with applicable local, global, and national laws, regulations, guidelines, codes of conduct, Company policies, and best practices. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role specifically with biological/biosimilar products is required. Experience in oncology, immunology, or hematology is preferred. The successful candidate will work within a global company recognized for its commitment to career development and diverse work environment.

6cba5b4fba81f65d.description: About the Role Solaiman A. ElKhereiji (SAK) Engineering Consultant Company is seeking an ELV Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems for a prestigious heritage project in Riyadh, which is part of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 initiative and targets Gold LEED certification. The role ensures that all ELV systems comply with project specifications, client requirements, industry standards, and operational needs, working closely with a team of over 80 site professionals. Key Responsibilities Review ELV system shop drawings, materials, and other submittals for compliance with design intent and technical specifications. Coordinate ELV installations with overall construction schedules. Interface with consultants, contractors, vendors, and client representatives. Resolve site coordination issues and clashes. Identify installation errors or equipment deficiencies, issue site instructions or snag lists, and verify contractor rectification. Monitor ELV contractor installation activities, conducting inspections and quality audits. Review O&M manuals and as-built documentation. Support project handover and warranty activities, participating in project closeout documentation and approvals. Ensure compliance with project quality standards and enforce safety regulations throughout the construction process. Provide guidance and support to engineering teams and junior engineers. Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure compliance with the design. Coordinate with the Client, PMC, contractors, other construction professionals, and the design team. Identify and resolve construction issues or discrepancies during the project. Provide regular progress reports to project managers and other stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant ELV engineering role. Demonstrated expertise in executing visions, managing resources, and delivering results within set timelines and budgets. Ability to ensure projects meet high standards of quality, sustainability, and design integrity. Application Information The expected joining time for this position is within 2 weeks. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

6cc884f43825c660.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking a Mechanical BIM Modeler to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves developing, coordinating, and maintaining accurate 3D BIM models for mechanical building services, ensuring compliance with project requirements, BIM Execution Plans (BEP), and company standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Mechanical BIM Modeler will be responsible for producing coordinated models, shop drawings, and construction documentation. This role also includes supporting multidisciplinary coordination throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring all mechanical systems are accurately represented and integrated within the overall building information model. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain detailed 3D BIM models for mechanical systems using Autodesk Revit. Model various mechanical building services, including HVAC, chilled water, ventilation, ductwork, piping systems, equipment rooms, mechanical plant rooms, smoke management systems, exhaust and fresh air systems, and medical gas systems (where applicable). Produce coordinated shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation drawings, and construction documentation. Generate schedules, material take-offs (MTO), and quantity reports from BIM models. Coordinate with Architectural, Structural, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, and Civil disciplines. Participate in clash detection and model coordination using Navisworks Manage. Resolve clashes and modeling issues in collaboration with engineers and BIM Coordinators. Ensure all models comply with project BIM standards, LOD requirements, and BIM Execution Plans (BEP). Update BIM models based on design revisions, RFIs, and site requirements. Maintain proper model organization, worksets, shared coordinates, and file management. Support the preparation of As-Built models at project completion. Deliver BIM outputs within project schedules while maintaining quality and accuracy. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a similar role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on collaborative project execution within a multidisciplinary team environment.

6cca9ae6f8433847.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايوان المتقدمة عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى مراقب الخدمات العامة مسؤولية الإشراف على الأنشطة اليومية لموظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على أولويات العمل. كما يركز الدور على تحسين الأداء وتنمية المهارات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية لتوثيق سير العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بما يتناسب مع حجم العمل وأولوياته وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات العلاقة لضمان التكامل. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل بشكل دوري، وتوثيقها وحفظها لضمان سهولة الرجوع إليها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الخدمات العامة أو دور إشرافي مماثل. القدرة على تنسيق المهام وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. القدرة على تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في تحسين كفاءة العمليات التشغيلية للخدمات العامة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

6ccab886cefb47ba.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة حسين العبدالله المزيد للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل والمشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل، وعرضها ومناقشتها مع الأطراف المعنية. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية وأنظمة الصيانة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام ومتابعة المشاريع. كيفية التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة حسين العبدالله المزيد للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

6cd213a37f6b2eb1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مشرف مكتب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان سير العمليات المكتبية بسلاسة وفعالية، من خلال الإشراف اليومي على المهام الإدارية والتنظيمية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف اليومي على كافة أعمال المكتب لضمان سلاسة الإجراءات المنفذة. متابعة جدولة المواعيد والتأكد من حسن سيرها وفقاً للخطط المحددة. ضمان تنظيم المكتب ونظافته، واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة للحفاظ على بيئة عمل مرتبة. التأكد من توافر جميع المستلزمات المكتبية الضرورية عند الحاجة ووفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل بشكل دوري، وتوثيقها وحفظها بدقة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على الإشراف وتنظيم المهام الإدارية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير وتوثيقها. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الحضور المنتظم في المكتب للإشراف على العمليات اليومية. عن شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة تلتزم شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة بتقديم بيئة عمل منظمة وفعالة، وتسعى لضم مشرف مكتب يساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف من خلال الإشراف الدقيق على سير العمليات المكتبية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

6c4f0418d2f882d7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة house refresh عن محاسب عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينتي الخبر والدمام. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة إدارة ومتابعة العمليات المحاسبية والمالية اليومية للشركة، مع ضمان دقة السجلات والتقارير المالية والالتزام بالمتطلبات النظامية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنة وسنتين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تسجيل ومراجعة القيود والعمليات المحاسبية اليومية بدقة. إدارة حسابات العملاء والموردين والذمم المدينة والدائنة. متابعة الفواتير والمبيعات والمشتريات والمصروفات وعمليات التحصيل. إجراء التسويات البنكية ومطابقة الحسابات المالية. متابعة المخزون ومطابقة العمليات المالية المرتبطة به. إعداد التقارير المالية والإقفالات الشهرية والسنوية. متابعة ضريبة القيمة المضافة والفوترة الإلكترونية ومتطلبات هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك. إعداد تقارير الإيرادات والمصروفات والتدفقات النقدية والمستحقات. استخدام أنظمة Zoho Books وZoho Inventory في العمليات المحاسبية. تنظيم وأرشفة المستندات والسجلات المالية بشكل منهجي. رفع التقارير والملاحظات المالية للإدارة بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنة وسنتين في مجال المحاسبة العامة. فهم جيد للمبادئ المحاسبية والمعايير المالية. القدرة على استخدام برامج المحاسبة، ويفضل أن يكون لديه خبرة في Zoho Books وZoho Inventory. الالتزام بالمتطلبات النظامية المتعلقة بالضرائب والجمارك. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب العام ضمن فريق شركة house refresh في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينتي الخبر والدمام. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً بإدارة العمليات المحاسبية اليومية بكفاءة ودقة. الراتب يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 1,875 ريال سعودي و 3,750 ريال سعودي. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق house refresh، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

6ca24af61f4db223.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Superintendent, HVAC Commissioning. This full-time role involves overseeing all aspects of HVAC pre-commissioning and commissioning for new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. The objective is to ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and efficient HVAC system operation, achieving operational readiness and successful client acceptance in line with project specifications, classification society requirements, and offshore regulatory standards. Role Purpose The Superintendent will manage the planning, coordination, execution, testing, startup, performance verification, and handover of HVAC systems. This includes accommodation, machinery, technical, hazardous area, and ventilation systems, ensuring all activities contribute to project delivery objectives and meet stringent industry standards. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee pre-commissioning, commissioning, functional testing, startup, and performance verification of HVAC systems, including those for accommodation, engine rooms, technical spaces, switchgear rooms, UPS rooms, and hazardous areas. Develop, implement, and control HVAC commissioning procedures, inspection checklists, test packages, and schedules to ensure systematic execution and timely project milestones. Oversee the inspection, testing, calibration, and operational validation of AHUs, chillers, compressors, fans, blowers, dampers, louvers, VFDs, and HVAC control systems. Manage the integration and functional verification of HVAC automation systems, control panels, monitoring systems, interlocks, and fire and gas interfaces. Coordinate commissioning activities with engineering, construction, QA/QC personnel, vendors, subcontractors, and client representatives. Lead engagements with classification societies, regulatory authorities, and client representatives during inspections, testing, audits, and approvals. Ensure all HVAC commissioning activities adhere to HSE requirements, permit-to-work processes, hazardous area regulations, SOLAS, IMO, and classification society standards. Lead troubleshooting, defect identification, punch-list management, corrective actions, and performance optimization activities. Oversee the preparation and control of commissioning dossiers, test records, inspection reports, ITRs, mechanical completion documentation, RFCC/RFOC certificates, and acceptance records. Direct FAT, SAT, final acceptance testing, system turnover, as-built documentation, and handover activities to ensure successful client acceptance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of experience in HVAC commissioning, preferably within the offshore or marine industry. Demonstrated ability to manage complex commissioning projects for HVAC systems on new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. Strong understanding of project specifications, classification society requirements, and offshore regulatory standards. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

6cba6f8b8fcf4151.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Chef de Cuisine to oversee the quality, consistency, and production of the restaurant kitchen in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a culinary professional with 5-10 years of experience who can lead a team while managing all food-related functions and ensuring high standards of guest and employee satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Develop and create new culinary applications, ideas, and products for the restaurant. Supervise restaurant kitchen shift operations, ensuring compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards, and procedures. Maintain proper food preparation, handling, and storage standards. Plan and manage food quantities and plating requirements, communicating production needs to key personnel. Assist in developing daily and seasonal menu items. Prepare and cook various food types for regular service, special guests, or functions. Check the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure standards are met. Determine food presentation and create decorative food displays. Team Leadership and Development Supervise and coordinate activities of cooks and other food preparation staff. Lead shift teams, personally preparing food items and executing requests. Manage day-to-day operations of the restaurant kitchen, understanding employee positions to perform duties in their absence. Encourage mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. Ensure and maintain employee productivity levels and cross-training for successful daily operations. Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with employees. Identify developmental needs and provide coaching, mentoring, and training. Participate in training restaurant staff on menu items, ingredients, and preparation methods. Operational Management and Standards Set and support the achievement of kitchen goals, including performance and budget targets. Develop specific guidance and plans to prioritize and organize daily kitchen operations. Understand the impact of kitchen operations on overall property financial goals and manage to achieve or exceed budgeted goals. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and company safety standards. Effectively investigate, report, and follow up on employee accidents. Customer Service Excellence Manage daily operations to ensure quality, standards, and customer expectations are met. Improve service by communicating guest needs and providing guidance and coaching to staff. Set a positive example for guest relations and emphasize guest satisfaction in all departmental meetings. Empower employees to provide excellent customer service and handle guest problems and complaints. Interact with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a culinary leadership role. Demonstrated culinary talent and ability to lead a kitchen team. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to manage operating budgets and financial decision-making. Commitment to maintaining sanitation and food safety standards. Experience in employee performance appraisal and progressive discipline procedures. Ability to assist in interviewing and hiring team members.

6c67ebdbb595e5a2.description: About the Role IFFCO is seeking an Associate Manager-Refinery.Production Refinery-Oils&Fats to join its team in KSA. This full-time position is responsible for ensuring the optimal utilization of production systems and methods to meet the routine requirements of various departments, institutional supplies, and sister companies. 6ca0e999a7a1d5da.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث المحافظة للتعليم عن أخصائي علاج وظيفي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم على أداء مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل، بالإضافة إلى تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم على تنفيذ مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل. تدريب المرضى على أداء الأنشطة اليومية مثل ارتداء الملابس والطهي وتناول الطعام. استخدام التمارين البدنية لزيادة القوة واستعادة البراعة الجسدية والتغلب على مشاكل التنسيق الحركي. تعليم ذوي الإعاقات الدائمة كيفية استخدام معدات التكيف، بما في ذلك الكراسي المتحركة والجبائر، والأدوات الخاصة المساعدة في تناول الطعام وارتداء الملابس. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. القدرة على مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم الوظيفية. معرفة جيدة بمعدات التكيف والأدوات المساعدة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. القدرة على تطوير أساليب عمل مبتكرة. الالتزام بمواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع المرضى لتقديم الدعم والعلاج اللازمين. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

6c1b01511756781e.description: نبحث عن مسوقة تجميل مبدعة وشغوفة للانضمام إلى فريقنا، لتكون المسؤولة عن الترويج لمنتجاتنا وخدماتنا المبتكرة في عالم الجمال، تقديم تجربة عملاء استثنائية. إذا كنت تتمتعين بمهارات تواصل قوية، وفهم عميق لسوق التجميل، وشغف بتحقيق النتائج، فإن هذه الفرصة المثالية لك. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: التفاعل مع العملاء: الترحيب بزيارات العملاء للجناح بأسلوب دافئ واحترافي، وجذب انتباه المارة واستقطابهم للتجربة. تقديم الاستشارات: تحليلي مبسط لنوع البشرة (جافة، دهنية، مختلطة، حساسة) واقتراح روتين العناية المخصص والمنتج الأنسب لكل حالة. عرض المنتجات وتجربتها: شرح المكونات والفوائد الرئيسية للمنتجات، وتطبيق العينات (Testers) للعملاء بأسلوب صحي وآمن. تحقيق أهداف المبيعات: إقناع العملاء بالمنتجات والحلول المطروحة، والعمل على تحقيق الهدف المالي اليومي والأسبوعي للمبيعات. المتطلبات والمهارات المطلوب توفرها: الخبرة: خبرة سابقة (من 0 إلى 2 سنوات) في مجال مبيعات التجزئة، ويفضل في قطاع العناية بالبشرة أو التجميل. المعرفة الفنية: دراية بأساسيات ومفاهيم العناية بالبشرة (أنواع البشرة، المكونات الشائعة مثل الهيالورونيك، النياسيناميد، فيتامين C، إلخ). مهارات التواصل: أسلوب لبق وجذاب في الحديث، وقدرة عالية على الإقناع والتأثير.

6c216bf11022d4c8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة انفال السعودية للمشاريع عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تنفيذ ومراقبة الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى تحديث بيانات الموظفين والتعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات كالترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم قوي لسياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية المتعلقة بالدوام والإجازات. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات وتحديثها بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تنفيذ الإجراءات. القدرة على حل المشكلات بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق ديناميكي لدعم العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية في الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

6c3d7105cb369a45.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عمر عبدالوهاب البدران عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد الإجراءات والتقارير اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل نتائجها. قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز باستخدام الأجهزة المتخصصة. توثيق نتائج القياسات ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار الناجمة مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات، وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن، وتعليمات الإخلاء. توعية العاملين بالتعليمات والإجراءات المعتمدة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالقوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على استخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية المختلفة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة لإجراء عمليات التفتيش والقياس والتحقيق. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

6ca57ec5725e77c9.description: About SPARK Logistics SPARK Logistics is seeking an experienced RTG Operator to join its team in Abqaiq, Saudi Arabia. A strong commitment to safe and efficient container handling practices. 5-10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. 6ca3e83470090382.description: We are looking for a Cost Estimator / Estimation Engineer to join the team of a fast-growing advertisement agency specializing in signages, branding, events, exhibitions, fabrication, and interior fit-out. In this role, you will be responsible for developing accurate and detailed project cost estimates by reviewing drawings, BOQs, specifications, and project requirements. You will work closely with the Sales, Design, Production, Procurement, and Project Teams to ensure projects are accurately priced and commercially viable. This is a hands-on estimation role suited to someone with experience in costing, quantity take-offs, materials, fabrication, and project pricing, particularly within the events, exhibitions, signage, advertising, or fit-out industries. Responsibilities Review project drawings, BOQs, specifications, scope of work, and client requirements. Prepare detailed costings sheets for exhibitions, events, booths, branding, signage, fabrication, fit-out, and related projects. Prepare and verify Bills of Quantities (BOQs) based on drawings and project requirements. Calculate quantities for materials, fabrication, installation, transportation, manpower, equipment, and subcontracted works. Obtain, review, and compare quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, fabricators, and service providers. Prepare detailed cost breakdowns covering materials, labor, equipment, transportation, installation, and subcontracting. Apply appropriate markup, overhead, profit margin, contingency, and other commercial allowances based on company requirements. Prepare final pricing and quotation sheets for submission to the Sales or Commercial Team. Coordinate with Sales, Design, Production, Procurement, and Project Teams to clarify requirements and ensure accurate costing. Identify potential cost implications, missing information, and technical or commercial requirements during the estimation process. Maintain accurate and organized costing records and estimation Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management 3–5 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing, quantity surveying, exhibitions, fit-out, signage, advertising, or fabrication. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas and costing spreadsheets. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, BOQs, layouts, and specifications. Good understanding of materials and works including MDF, plywood, acrylic, aluminum, PVC, digital printing, lighting, electrical works, carpentry, and metal fabrication. Strong numerical and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations. Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Experience in one or more of the following industries is preferred: Events, Exhibitions, Signage, Advertising, Branding, Fabrication, Interior Fit-Out, Retail Displays, or Digital Printing.

6cfffe57879ce532.description: About the Role: Senior Manager Virtual City CDU Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Manager Virtual City CDU to join its Central Development Unit (CDU) in Riyadh. This full-time role is dedicated to the technical oversight and quality control of digital assets within Qiddiya City's Unreal Engine environment. The position requires deep technical expertise and meticulous attention to detail to ensure compliance with established standards. Revenue Intelligence · Build and maintain weekly visibility on revenue across B2B, B2C, and Homecare · Analyze performance by branch, product, and channel · Identify key revenue drivers, trends, and revenue leakages 2.
